gloss: space under the floor; behind the scenes

definitions.gloss: space beneath the floor (of a traditional house)
definitions.explanation: The open space under the raised floor and veranda of a traditional Japanese house.

definitions.gloss: behind the scenes; out of sight
definitions.explanation: Unseen, supporting work, almost always in the idiom {縁|えん}の{下|した}の{力持|ちからも}ち: someone who does important work that nobody notices.

examples.english: There's a cat under the floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転|ころ}がり{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The ball rolled under the veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{床|ゆか}→床：03652_yuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧、{縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通|とお}る→通る：01243_tooru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作|つく}られていた→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Old houses had raised floors, built so that air could flow underneath.

examples.japanese: {縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力持|ちからも}ち。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力持|ちからも}ちだ。
examples.english: She is the team's unsung hero.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大会|たいかい}→大会：03386_taikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支|ささ}えた→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧だ。
examples.english: The tournament succeeded thanks to the volunteers who supported it behind the scenes.

notes:
{縁|えん} here is the veranda (⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧), not ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ "fate, bond."

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {縁|えん}の{下|した}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力持|ちからも}ち: literally "the strong man under the floor"; a person whose hard work supports others without recognition. Used as praise, of oneself only modestly.
